_about: Build 53: nightmare mode (src/campaign/camp-nightmare.js, docs/CAMPAIGN.md 'Nightmare'). Unlocked by winning the last island's last level. The Maw's body is the Coil; under each island, from the top down, a tunnel is dug: 10 levels and the Maw. The roots of the Great Tree hang into every tunnel (global nightmare upgrades, one set per island), and after level 5 a shop sells nightmare-only things for the island's money at nightmare prices. ALL NUMBERS ARE PLACEHOLDERS FOR PLAYTESTING.
_economy: payMult: a nightmare win pays this many times a normal one (on a base of a level 15 + n); priceMult: nightmare shop prices against the merchant's for that family and rarity; rootCost: each root's tiers, times the tunnel's depth (1 for the first tunnel ... 5).
_base: Which of the island's own levels each tunnel level is built on: its goal, spawns and board (turned a quarter turn, in content/levels/nightmare/).
_maw: The Maw, fought at the end of every tunnel (its last-stand fight). Its numbers grow by 'perTunnel' for each tunnel down. Once beaten it turns from 'body' to 'slainBody' on the map.
_snakes: The enemy snakes of the deep. from: the first level (counting every tunnel's levels in a row, 1 to 50) where it turns up. Each level brings the newest three it can. bite: hearts; hit: its damage tags. go: head (chases you), cut (gets in front of you), loot (takes keys, pouches, relics, trinkets and apples). pace: its step against yours (higher = slower).
_roots: The Great Tree's roots in each tunnel: upgrades that work in every nightmare level, never above ground. stat: a stat the level reads (the rune stats, the damage stats, and nmSnakeSlow: % slower snakes); v: per tier; cost: per tier, in that tunnel's money, times its depth.

upgrades.name: Wellspring
upgrades.text: Free spell casts every nightmare level.

_items: Things only the deep sells. They work like the item named in 'acts' (or are data like any rune), go in the same slots, and can be fitted, trained and cooked in the normal workshops. 'look': the item whose picture they're drawn from (textures/items/nightmare/). sold: the rarities the nightmare shop offers.

items.name: Mawfang
items.does: A tooth pried from the Maw. Kills what you run into, poisons bosses and slips through their armor.
items.weak: Heavy to swing: it wears out on hazards like any blade.
items.legend: Its blows land twice as hard.

items.name: Gullet Cleaver
items.does: Forged in the Cinder Gullet. Cuts down what you hit and the ones beside it, and leaves bosses burning.
items.weak: Ice-born things shrug off the burn.
items.legend: Its blows land twice as hard.

items.name: Rootlash
items.does: Roots burst from the walls and hold every hazard, enemy and boss where it is for a few seconds.
items.strong: Swarms, cutters, a boss on the charge

items.name: Gloomfire
items.does: A ball of black fire that burns and poisons whatever it hits.
items.strong: Bosses that shrug off plain fire

items.name: Ash Cake
items.does: Baked in a buried oven. Heals more than a stew.
items.weak: Can't heal past your full hearts.

items.name: Duskberry
items.does: The deep's snakes and enemies lose your scent for a while.
items.legend: Enemies that touch you are stunned.

items.name: Lantern Grub
items.does: A glowing grub from the roots: fetches apples, lights the dark.
items.legend: Fetched apples count double, and Toxin Immunity.

items.name: Rootling
items.does: A knot of living root that takes a hit for you, then grows back.
items.weak: Slow to grow back; no help against walls.
items.legend: Starts every level ready, plus one extra.

items.name: Rune of the Maw
items.does: Hunger carved in stone: far more money and harder blows, for a heart.

items.name: Rune of Dusk
items.does: Quiet in the dark: fewer hazards and more finds, but everything moves faster.

_posters: Title screen (camp-title.js): the Maw's wanted poster once nightmare is open, crossed out after the fifth Maw; its sticker for each Maw beaten. 'stickerSlots' are the spots kept free for the quest bosses' stickers to come (no posters for those).
